variants.headline: Assembly votes the government out
variants.body: The Colonial Assembly has voted the government out in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Confidence withdrawn
variants.body: The government has been voted out by the Colonial Assembly. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Office meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: An Assembly vote has removed the government in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
